parts.text: That was a bad day. The trees are still there.
Back to the bank box. Then the hill.
They took the ore. Not my life.
I am not staying down.
The river is still there.
Still have walking to do.
I can still swing an axe.
Pack empty. I start again.
The smith will wait one more hour.
Wet, poorer, standing. Fine.
I banked nothing. I still bank tomorrow.
Death is a pause in the errands.
The vendor upkeep is still due.
Back on the steps. Coin in the box next time.
The west wood did not keep me.
Death is a pause. Not the end.
Back on my feet. The crew waits.
That was poorly done.
I have more spells yet.
I will do better.
Still standing. Still learning.
I am not done yet.
Get up. Swing again.
Still here.
The dark did not keep me.
Still walking.
The road did not keep me.
Died on the wave. Next time I hold.
Back. The altar is still burning.
Resurrected. Reagents next. Then steel.
Still here. The crowd kept me.
A shout is not a sentence.
I left the pack. I kept the feet.
Night will be kinder.
The steps did not keep me.
Empty hands again. Fine.
I do not argue with guards. I leave.
Back to shadow.
A bad lift. A living thief.
The fence can wait.
I will not try the same banker twice.
Gone, then back. That is the work.
They saw a cloak. Not a name.
Still walking. Still quiet.
The window can wait a night.
The field kept me. I came back anyway.
Still walking. The follower had better be.
I should have stabled first.
The beast is the prize. I am replaceable.
Back. Check the stable. Then breathe.
A bad road. A living tamer.
I will not take them there again.
Meat, water, shade. Then I stand.
The bond held. I did not.
Town can wait. The animal cannot.
Still here. Still speaking soft.
I lost the day. Not the name.
Get up. Call them. Walk.
The west fields will not mock me.
Resurrected. I go to the stable first.
Back. My house was greatly worn. Refreshed it.
Back. Had to refresh the house before it fell.
Back from Luna. The mall was packed.
Back. Turned in a stack of bulk orders.
Home from Malas. The forge there is quiet.
Back. Found a runic hammer in my bank. Forgot.
Back from Heartwood. The elves wanted more cloth.
Back from Trammel side. Much quieter work.
Back from the Felucca mines. Still alive, somehow.
Back from Ter Mur. Imbuing is harder than it looks.
Back. What did I miss?
Back again. Forge still hot?
Sorry, got pulled away. Where was I?
Ok, I am back. The ore will not mine itself.
Anyone still around? I am back.
Back from the bank. Pack is empty again.
Had to sell the logs first. Back now.
Made it back from Minoc. Long walk.
Returned from Vesper. Prices are up there.
Britain was too crowded. Glad to be back.
Home from the mines. My arms are dead.
The smith paid well today. Back and happy.
Vendor needed restocking. All done now.
Yew has plenty of trees left. Back with logs.
Took the ferry from Skara Brae. Here now.
Sold my scrolls in Moonglow. Back with gold.
Home again. The house is still standing.
Missed the anvil. Good to be back.
Right, where did I leave off on this robe?
Here again. Fish waiting for me?
Slept at the inn. Feels good to be up.
That nap was needed. Ready now.
Long night. Back at it anyway.
Rain held me up on the road. Here now.
Snow on the Minoc road. Took forever.
Fog in Yew slowed me down. Sorry.
Ferry was late again. Finally here.
The moongate sent me to Trinsic first. Ugh.
Recalled to the wrong rune. Took a while.
Took the long way around the mountain.
Walked the whole road. My legs are done.
Pack horse wandered off. Found him by the river.
Had to fetch more ore. Back to smelting.
Went to buy tongs. Took an hour to find some.
Got a new pickaxe. The old one gave out.
Tinker was out of shovels. Found one in Cove.
Provisioner had everything for once.
Bought flour for bread. Oven time.
Picked up thread from the weaver. Sewing again.
Grabbed more cloth on the way back.
Dyed a few robes while I was away.
Knocked out a few chairs before I came back.
Scribed a stack of recall scrolls while gone.
Mixed potions all morning. Here now.
Brewed a keg of ale. It is terrible.
Caught a few fish on the way over.
Ate at the inn. Full and ready.
Baked bread before I came back. Want some?
Farm run done. Got carrots and onions.
Cotton is ready in the field. Picked a load.
Sheared the sheep. Wool for days.
Finished spinning the wool. Loom next.
Came back from the forest with arms full of logs.
Swamp trip done. Found ginseng and a bog thing.
The reagent shop finally had mandrake.
Regs are dear at the mage shop today.
Paid my vendor upkeep. Wallet hurts.
My vendor sold out overnight. Nice surprise.
Vendor made one sale while I was away. One.
Came back to find I got undercut next door.
The mall walk took forever. Nothing good.
Found ingots at 5 a piece on my way back.
Resold those ingots already. Easy profit.
Good trades while I was out.
Lost gold on a bad deal. Never again.
Nobody buys logs anymore. Came back with them all.
Iron prices crashed while I was gone. Great.
Someone placed a house on my spot while I slept.
My mining spot is gone. Walls everywhere.
Came back to find my cave claimed.
That earth elemental is still in the mine.
Ran from a troll on the way back. Barely.
Ogre chased me out of the mine. Back in town.
Reds at the mine, so I came home early.
A red killed me. Lost the ore. Back anyway.
Back from the dead. The healer was kind.
Death robe again. Still counts as back.
Death is cold. Glad to have a body again.
Lost my pickaxe when I died. Need another.
The PK took my ingots. He can have them.
The ore is gone. I am not.
Ghosts walk slow. Took me ages to get here.
Took forever to find a healer out there.
The healer in Minoc had a line of ghosts.
Rezzed at the shrine. Back to work.
A kind mage rezzed me on the road.
I owe that mage a drink for the rez.
Corpse run done. Got my tools back.
Found my corpse. A thief got there first.
Only my tools were left on the body.
At least they left the pickaxe.
Pack was empty when I died. Good thing I banked.
Always bank first. Learned it again today.
Never carry what you can not lose.
New robe, new day.
Starting over from nothing. Fine by me.
Fresh start. Let me find my tools.
Clean slate and a full bank. Could be worse.
Rested up. Let us get to work.
Back in the mine. Smells the same.
The trees missed me, I think.
Hammer in hand again. Feels right.
Needle and thread again. Where was that pattern?
Line in the water again. Come on, fish.
The oven is warm. Pies coming up.
Quill in hand. Let us scribe.
Where did everyone go while I was out?
Town is quiet. Everyone asleep?
The bank got packed while I was gone.
Forge is crowded now. I will wait.
Somebody took my loom.
Docks are empty. More fish for me.
Everyone must be at the event.
Did I miss the event? Tell me I did not.
Did the GMs do something while I was away?
Someone said a dragon was in town. True?
Did the daemons come back? Everyone fine?
What is the news? I was gone a while.
Any rumors while I was out?
Did I miss the guild meeting? Sorry.
Guild meeting over already?
Did the guild vendor sell out?
Paid the guild dues on my way in.
Orders are open again. Ask away.
Taking orders now. Plate, weapons, tools.
Shop is open again. Come see.
Restocked the vendor on my way back.
Fresh stock at my vendor. Go look.
New prices on the vendor. Lower.
Wts ingots. Just got back from the smelter.
Still looking for feathers. Wtb, paying fair.
Back with a load of logs. Wts, cheap.
Anyone need repairs? I am here now.
Repairs are 50 gold each. Line up.
Free repairs for friends today.
My hands missed the hammer. My back did not.
My feet hurt from the road.
I smell like fish. Sorry about that.
I smell like smoke. The forge got me.
Sawdust everywhere. Even in my boots.
Ore dust in my hair. It never leaves.
The ale was good. I may be a bit slow.
Home from the tavern. Feeling fine.
Home from the tavern. Feeling less fine.
The barmaid says hello to all of you.
The miners send their best.
The carpenter asked about you all.
The tailor wants her thread back.
The fisher wants his bait money.
The cook wants her flour.
The scribe needs blank scrolls. Anyone?
The alchemist wants bottles. Lots.
The bowyer wants feathers again.
Everyone wanted something from me today.
Slow day out there. Glad to be here.
Busy day out. Finally sitting down.
Long day. Short temper. Give me a moment.
Home early. Nothing was biting.
Odd day. A chicken followed me the whole way.
Came back soaked. The rain came sideways.
Hot out there. My leather is sticking to me.
Freezing out there. My fingers will not bend.
Windy on the bridge. Almost lost my hat.
Good morning, all. Up early today.
Evening. Just back from a full day of work.
Midnight and back at the forge. Why not.
Made it back before dark. Barely.
Sun is up and so am I.
Took a week off. Did anything change?
Been a while. Is the Minoc forge still there?
Gone a month. My vendor ran dry.
Long time away. My skills feel rusty.
Away too long. The house needs a refresh.
Back after a long break. Who is new?
Ok, where did I put my tongs?
Did someone move my anvil? Kidding.
My forge went cold while I was away.
The coals are still warm. Not gone that long.
My pack is lighter than I left it. Hmm.
Did anyone touch my logs by the bank?
My log pile is still here. Miracle.
My ore stack by the forge is gone. Of course.
Came back to a full bank box. Must sort it.
Bank box is a mess. Sorting before work.
Checked the bank. Gold is all there.
Counted my gold twice. Still short. Taxes?
Returned from Trinsic with a sack of sand.
Trinsic beach sand for the glass kilns. Back.
Home from Jhelom. The pits were loud.
Came back from Serpent's Hold with shield orders.
Nujel'm trip done. Sold every fancy shirt.
Magincia buyers took all my cloth. Home now.
Returned from Buc's Den. Never again.
Buc's Den fence tried to cheat me. Home safe.
Ocllo wheat is loaded up. Back to bake.
Came back from Cove with orc blood on my boots.
Wind mages paid for my scrolls. Here again.
Delucia merchants bought my plate. Home now.
Back from Papua. Brought strange wood.
The Lost Lands trip paid off. Home with ore.
Took the boat out. Came back with a full hold.
Sailed back from Moonglow. Sea was calm.
Our boat hit rough water. Made it though.
Sea serpent chased the boat. Home at last.
Lost my boat key. Walked back from the docks.
Fishing trip is over. Two fish and a boot.
Pulled up a tattered map while I was out.
Found an old chest on the beach. Empty.
Got caught in a storm off Vesper. Soaked.
Escorted a merchant to Minoc. Paid well.
The escort to Britain went smooth. Here now.
Escort died halfway. No pay. Back anyway.
Ran a load of ore to Vesper for a friend.
Delivered the chairs to the Vesper inn.
Dropped off a suit of plate in Trinsic.
The guard captain liked the armor. Back now.
Customer paid in fish. Back with fish.
Made the delivery. Nobody robbed me. Good.
Robbed on the road. Only lost some cloth.
A thief lifted my pouch in Britain. Back poorer.
Gold is safe in the bank. I checked first.
Stopped by the house on the way. All good.
House still locked up. Nothing missing.
Somebody left a note on my door. Order for plate.
My mailbox is full of orders. I mean my door.
Found three customers waiting at my vendor.
Old customer found me at the forge. Back to work.
Came back to a line at my shop.
Came back to an empty shop. Fine.
Came back and the vendor had a sign stolen.
The stable kept my pack llama fed. Back now.
Picked up my pack horse from the stable.
Horse is rested. So am I.
Llama is loaded. Let us go.
Rested the mule. I mean the horse. Ready.
Took a swim in the river. Refreshed.
Washed the coal dust off. Human again.
Changed into a clean apron.
New gloves. The old ones burned through.
Found my lucky hat. Everything is fine now.
My lucky pickaxe is back from repair.
Tinker fixed my sextant. Back on the water.
Got my scissors sharpened. Cutting again.
New saw from the carpenter. Back to boards.
Fresh quill and ink. Scribing again.
New mortar and pestle. Alchemy time.
Filled my keg with fresh heal potions.
Stocked up on empty bottles in Britain.
Bought a new cooking pot. Back to the stove.
New fishing pole. Old one snapped on a serpent.
Replaced my smith hammer. Swings true now.
Bought a better anvil for the house.
Hauled a loom home. Took two trips.
Brought back a spinning wheel from Yew.
Found a cheap dye tub. Back to dyeing.
Got my rune for the good cave back.
Remarked my mining rune. Old one faded.
Copied my forge rune for the guild.
Runebook recharged. Ready to travel.
Out of recall scrolls, so I walked back.
Paid a mage for a gate home. Money well spent.
Walked from Yew to Britain. Never again.
Hitched a ride on a boat back to Vesper.
Ferry from Skara Brae finally arrived.
Took the moongate home. Only took two tries.
Bridges in Vesper are slippery today.
Minoc gate was crowded with miners.
Road from Cove was clear. No orcs.
Saw orcs near Cove on the way. Hid.
Headless near Yew chased me home.
A mongbat followed me all the way back.
Deer followed me from the woods. Odd.
A bear crossed my path. We both backed away.
Wolves howling on the road. I ran.
Walked through the graveyard. Never again.
Snakes in the swamp on the way. Hate snakes.
Got bit by a giant spider. Bandaged and back.
Poisoned on the road. Cured and back.
Healer in Vesper fixed me up.
Drank a heal potion and walked home.
Sore but alive. Back at work.
A few bruises from the road. Nothing broken.
Tired but back.
Hungry but back. Anyone got bread?
Thirsty. Let me get water first.
Full belly and fresh legs. Let us go.
Rested, fed, ready.
Slept like a rock. Mining like a rock now.
Dreamed of ingots. Now let us make some.
Woke up with a plan. Plate all day.
Woke up early. Beat the crowd to the mine.
Late start today. Overslept at the inn.
The rooster at the inn woke me. Here now.
Innkeeper overcharged me. Back anyway.
Rented a room in Minoc. Cozy.
Stayed the night in Vesper. Nice inn.
The Yew abbey let me sleep in the barn.
Camped in the woods. Back at dawn.
Campfire kept me warm all night.
Camping by the mine saved a walk.
Hid in my house during the storm.
Stayed in while the reds roamed. Safe now.
Waited out the PKs in the bank. Back to work.
Reds left the mine. I can go back.
Guards cleared the gate. Coming through.
All clear on the Minoc road. Heading out.
The mine is empty now. Perfect.
The woods are quiet again.
Docks are calm. Back to fishing.
Market is open again. Back to selling.
Shops opened again after the event.
Event is over. Back to the grind.
Missed the event. Heard it was good.
Saw the event. A dragon in the square!
Back from the event. My pack is full of candy.
Holiday crowd is gone. Town is ours again.
The fair left town. Quiet again.
Wedding was lovely. Back to work.
Funeral was sad. Back to work, though.
Guild meeting ran long. Here now.
Guild voted on new colors. Back to the forge.
Guild hall needs chairs. On it.
Guildmaster asked for fifty bandages. Making them.
Friend needed help moving. All done.
Helped a newbie with his first sword.
Showed a newbie the mines. He found iron.
Gave a newbie some fish. Felt good.
Taught a newbie to fish. He caught a boot.
That brb took longer than planned. Here now.
Sorry about that. Had to deal with something.
Apologies, friends. Got held up.
Sorry for vanishing. Back to the anvil.
I left mid sentence, did I not? Sorry.
Where were we? Ingot prices, I think.
Lost my train of thought. What were we saying?
Did I miss anything good?
Tell me I did not miss a sale.
Did the buyer for the plate come by?
Did anyone ask for me while I was gone?
Anyone looking for a tailor while I was away?
Did the carpenter come by for the boards?
Did someone take those logs? They were for a friend.
Who ate my fish steak? It was right here.
My bread is gone. Someone was hungry.
Somebody sat on my stool at the forge.
Someone used my dye tub. Everything is pink.
Someone borrowed my saw and did not return it.
The loom is still threaded. Nobody touched it.
My vendor survived the week. Good vendor.
The house plants died while I was gone.
Door was unlocked. Oops. Nothing missing, luckily.
I forgot to lock the door. Everything is still here.
Came home to a chest of fish in my hall. Gift?
My neighbor left me a bag of carrots. Kind.
Friend left me a bolt of silk. Thanks, whoever.
Guild left me a stack of ore. Nice folks.
Somebody left a note. Wants a bardiche.
Found a letter on the door. Price complaint.
Picked up an order for twenty barrels.
Got an order for a whole suit of plate.
Big order came in. Going to be a long night.
Small order today. A single kryss.
Cleared the backlog of orders. Free now.
Came back to eight repair requests.
Stack of broken swords waiting for me.
Somebody dropped their broken plate on my porch.
Came home to a pile of bent helms.
Back at the kiln. Glass does not wait.
Kiln is hot again. Bottles by noon.
Cleaned out the smelter. Ready for ore.
Swept the shop. Sawdust was ankle deep.
Oiled the spinning wheel. No more squeak.
Fixed the leak in the roof. Back to smithing.
Built a new shelf while I was away.
Carved a sign for the shop. Hung it up.
Painted the shop door. Green now.
Rearranged the vendor. Plate in front now.
Put the good bows on display.
Hid the cheap daggers in the back.
Priced everything down ten percent.
Raised prices on plate. Iron went up.
Checked the other vendors. Mine are cheaper.
Scouted the Britain mall. Nobody sells boards.
Found a gap in the market. Selling lanterns.
Nobody sells good hats. Making hats now.
Heard the Trinsic guards want new shields.
Heard the Moonglow scholars want ink.
Heard the Yew monks want honey.
Heard the Vesper sailors want rope.
Heard the Jhelom duelists want bandages.
Heard the Minoc miners want pickaxes.
Heard the Britain bakers want flour.
Heard the Magincia nobles want silk.
Returned with a plan to get rich. Again.
Returned with no plan. Just mining.
Back with fresh ideas for the shop.
Came back with a new pattern for cloaks.
Learned a new recipe for fish pie.
Worked out a better way to cut boards.
Found a quicker road to the mine.
Discovered a quiet cave north of Vesper.
Found a grove near Yew nobody knows about.
Found a fishing hole in the hills.
Back with a secret. Not telling.
Back with gossip. Who wants to hear?
Heard the miners guild is splitting.
Heard a smith in Minoc hit legendary.
Heard a tailor got robbed at the bank.
Heard the Vesper bridge is getting repaired.
Heard the ferry is getting a new captain.
Heard wolves got into the Britain farms.
Heard orcs raided a camp near Cove.
Heard a dragon flew over Minoc. Doubt it.
Heard ghosts in the Minoc mines. Did not see any.
Heard someone found gold in Covetous. Sure.
Returned from a walk. Needed air.
Took a stroll around the lake. Better now.
Went to watch the sunset. Worth it.
Watched the ships come in at Vesper.
Sat on the Britain bridge for a while.
Fed the ducks by the river.
Picked some flowers for the house.
Visited the shrine of Humility. Quiet place.
Visited the shrine of Honesty on the way back.
Prayed at the Yew abbey. Feel lighter.
Stopped by the Britain library. Read a bit.
Bought a book in Moonglow. Reading tonight.
Wrote a letter to a friend in Trinsic.
Visited family in Skara Brae.
Saw an old friend in Vesper. Caught up.
Met a new customer on the road.
Made a new friend at the inn.
Lost a friend to the reds. Sad day.
Buried an old friend near Yew. Back now.
Not a good week. But I am back.
Needed some time away. Better now.
Took a few days to rest. Ready again.
Was away for a while. Glad to see you all.
Did not think I would come back. Here I am.
Could not stay away from the forge.
The mine calls. I answer.
The trees called me back.
Could not stay off the water for long.
The loom called. I came.
Ahh, the smell of the forge. Home.
Ahh, the smell of fresh bread. Home.
Ahh, the smell of pine. Home.
Nothing like getting back to work.
Home sweet forge.
Home is where the anvil is.
Anvil, I missed you.
Sorry, pickaxe. I will not leave you again.
My old hammer still fits my hand.
Tools right where I left them. Good.
Let us see what I forgot how to do.
Hope I still remember how to smelt.
Skills feel rusty. First batch will be rough.
First plate back and it came out exceptional.
First fish back and it is a big one.
First tree back and the axe broke. Typical.
First try back and I failed. Welcome home.
Ready to make some gold again.
Ready to pay off that house.
Ready to fill the bank again.
Ready for a full day of work.
Ready for a long night at the loom.
Ready for a quiet day on the water.
Ready to hammer until dawn.
Let us go. Ore awaits.
Right then. To the forge.
Off to the mine again. Back later.
Honest work waited for me. Here I am.
Wet boots again, but I made it back.
The tavern owes me a meal. Back from the road.
Pack full, road empty, home safe.
Back from the champ spawn. No scroll this time.
Returned from Doom. Lost half my suit.
Back. Insurance saved my gear again.
Home from Ilshenar. The lich hordes were thick.
Back from Felucca. Ganked twice.
Back in Trammel. Nice and safe.
Back from Tokuno. Strange lands.
Back from Malas. The dungeons there are huge.
Back. My tithing points ran dry. Need to donate.
Returned from the Luna bank. Crowded as ever.
Back from the altar. The champion fell.
Back from the Abyss. My arms are jelly.
Returned from Ter Mur. Gargoyles everywhere.
Back. Who wants to hunt?
Back from the dead. Who killed me? Oh right, the lich.
Rezzed and ready. Where is my corpse?
Back on my feet. That dragon owes me.
Back in the land of the living.
Returned from Despise. Ettins everywhere.
Home from Covetous. Harpies broke my bow.
Back from Destard. Scales in the pack.
Made it out of Shame alive.
Back from Deceit. Bones everywhere.
Returned from Hythloth. Barely.
Back from Wrong. What a maze.
Home from the Ice dungeon. Frozen to the bone.
Back from Fire. My armor is still warm.
Out of Terathan Keep. Spiders in my hair.
Back from the Orc Cave. Orc stink on everything.
Back from the Lost Lands. Wild country.
Back from Papua. The jungle almost ate me.
Home from Delucia. Tough orcs out there.
Back. Group got wiped at the ettin room.
Back. The whole crew died but me.
Back. I was the only one to die. Embarrassing.
Back. Recalled out just in time.
Back. Ran out of mana. Had to run.
Back. Out of bandages. Had to leave.
Back. Out of potions. Had to recall.
Back. Out of arrows. Had to go home.
Back. Out of regs. Came home.
Back. My sword broke. Came home.
Back. Armor fell apart. Needs a smith.
Back. Lost my spellbook. Do not ask.
Back. Dropped my bow in the lava. Ugh.
Back. Lich took my good katana.
Back. Reds took my whole suit.
Back. PK ambush at Destard.
Back. Got ganked at the Yew gate.
Back. Three reds on one. Did not stand a chance.
Back. Killed two reds before they got me.
Back. Got revenge on that red.
Back. Guards got the red. Justice.
Back. The bounty board has my killer now.
Back. Collected a bounty. Good gold.
Back from the duel. Won.
Back from the pits. Lost.
Back from the Jhelom pits. Split wins and losses.
Back from sparring. Sore but better.
Back from training at the dummy.
Back from the archery butte. Aim is improving.
Back. Tactics went up while I was out.
Back. Swords hit GM on the last swing.
Back. Magery up a point. Slow going.
Back. Resist finally moving.
Back. Healing is at 100 now.
Back. Parry went up two points.
Back. Archery at GM. Took forever.
Back. Stats capped. Finally.
Back. Fame went up. Must have killed something big.
Back. Karma dropped. Hit a blue by mistake.
Back. Criminal flag cleared.
Back. Stayed out of town until the flag passed.
Back. Guards almost got me. My fault.
Back. Apologized to the blue I hit.
Back. Group is reforming at the bank.
Back. Anyone still want to hunt?
Back. Need a new group.
Back. Who is up for round two?
Back. Same dungeon, one more time?
Back. That was fun. Again?
Back. Resting up before the next run.
Back. Healing up. Five minutes.
Back. Meditating. Give me a moment.
Back. Bandaging. Almost ready.
Back. Restocking regs. Then we go.
Back. Buying potions. Meet at the gate.
Back. Grabbing arrows. One moment.
Back. Getting a new sword. Be right there.
Back. Repairs first. Then the hunt.
Back from the smith. Armor is fixed.
Back from the mage shop. Full of regs.
Back from the healer. Good as new.
Back from the bank. Gold is safe.
Back from the tailor. New robe.
Back from the bowyer. Full quiver.
Back from the alchemist. Pockets full of potions.
Back from the tavern. Ready to fight.
Back from a long rest. Bones feel young.
Back after a week off. Rusty.
Back after a month away. Anyone remember me?

Back. Guild still around?
Back. Guild war still on?
Back. Who won the war?
Back. Did Order win? Did Chaos?
Back. Reds still camping Despise?
Back. PKs still at the gate?
Back. Is the moongate safe?
Back. Any news from the front?
Back. What did the guild do while I was gone?
Back. Missed the big hunt, did I?
Back. Missed the guild meeting. Sorry.
Back. Missed the dragon kill? Tell me no.
Back. Heard you took down a balron. Gz.
Back. Heard the event had daemons. Missed it.
Back. Heard a lich lord was in town.
Back. Heard reds raided the Britain bank.
Back. Any rumors?
Ok, I am up. Who rezzed me? Thanks.
Thanks for the rez. I owe you one.
That lich lord hits harder than I remembered.
Never again will I pull two ettins.
Note to self: do not fight a dragon in a death robe.
Lesson learned. Bring more cure potions to Shame.
Well, that went poorly. Here I am anyway.

Saw a fisher asleep on the docks. Let him sleep.
Saw a miner with a full pack. Too heavy to lift.
Saw a tamer with a dragon. Walked the other way.
Saw a warrior count his gold on the steps. Fool.
Saw it all from the rooftop.
Saw nothing, heard nothing. As usual.
Remember nothing. As usual.
Nothing happened. Nothing at all.
Whatever you heard, it was not me.
